hero_desc: Report village civic issues directly to your Gram Panchayat administrators. Track resolution progress in real time with 100% transparency.
cat_subheading: Identified through extensive door-to-door field survey in Venkatapuram Village
cat_water_desc: Report pipeline leakages, RO plant issues, water contamination, or irregular supply timings.
cat_roads_desc: Report deep craters, broken pavement on link roads, and damaged culverts.
cat_lights_desc: Report non-functioning LED streetlights, dark spots, and damaged light poles.
cat_drainage_desc: Report clogged side drains, monsoon overflow, foul smell, and mosquito breeding spots.
cat_garbage_desc: Report missed tractor rounds, open dumping on vacant lands, and overflowing bins.
cat_electricity_desc: Report agricultural low voltage, transformer sparks, and loose overhead wires.
cat_other_desc: Any other public amenity concern affecting village welfare.
how_subheading: Simple 4-step process for fast civic resolution
step_1_desc: Describe the issue, specify your ward/street, and attach a photo.
step_2_desc: Receive instant tracking number (e.g., SCM-2026-0001) via portal.
step_3_desc: Panchayat Secretary reviews, assigns staff, and starts field work.
step_4_desc: Work is verified, photographic proof attached, and grievance closed.
